thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod: 5xx-rate on /v1/generate above 1.5% (5m) — triggered 2026-02-20 01:00:00 UTC — severity: P2 — PagerDuty paged on-call
maria: oncall here, looking. seeing a spike in 5xx and gateway 504s. assigning self to triage.
chris: API gateway logs point to upstream 'gen-proxy-a' returning 502/504 frequently. tailing logs now:
```
2026-02-20T01:00:12Z gen-proxy-a 502 GET /v1/generate 0.234s "upstream timeout"
2026-02-20T01:01:05Z gen-proxy-a 504 POST /v1/generate 1.002s "gateway timeout"
```
taylor: quick synth check — region-us and region-eu canaries show ~80% failures to /v1/generate in last 5m.
sam: mitigation idea: increase gateway timeouts to 10s and shift some traffic to gen-proxy-b while we investigate.
maria: agree. also we'll mute noisy PD pages for 30m while stabilizing. I'll add a suppression for alertname=High5xxRate on prod:/v1/generate.
chris: changing routing now — shifting 30% traffic to gen-proxy-b. command used:
```
routectl set-weight gen-proxy-a=70 gen-proxy-b=30 --service api-gateway
```
maria: applied gateway timeout bump 3s -> 10s (temp). patch: 
```
service api-gateway {
  request_timeout: 10s
}
```
taylor: created a temp dashboard panel "5xx by upstream" and added filters for gen-proxy-a/gen-proxy-b. link: https://console.redwood/observability/d/abc123/5xx-upstream
leah: i'm taking handoff at 01:30 UTC — leaving routing + timeout changes in place. @maria please handoff customer-impact notes.
leah: customer-impact summary: peak 5xx ~5% globally, ~2.1k failed requests/min at peak. Affected customers: batch inference customers in EU (cust-102, cust-187), and a few low-volume enterprise tenants saw timeouts. Drafting PSR.
sam: opened incident ticket INC-2026-045 and linked runbook. Assigned to eng-sre.
maria: decisions for short-term: (1) keep PD suppressed for 30m, (2) tune alert to split gateway 502/504 vs origin 500, (3) add per-region synthetic checks, (4) add auto-fallback routing policy: if upstream error > 2% for 3m shift 50% traffic. I'll create follow-ups.
taylor: proposed temporary alert rule (bump threshold to 3% for gateway-level paging):
```
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api-gateway\", code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api-gateway\"}[5m])) > 0.03
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High 5xx rate on job=api-gateway (>3%)"
```
chris: +1 to bump to 3% for gateway (502/504); keep origin-500s alert at 1.5% so we still page on real app errors.
leah: holding on wide customer broadcast until we confirm root cause, aiming for 01:50 UTC to send update.
maria: monitoring shows 5xx rate dropped to 0.9% after routing + timeout changes. will unmute alerts in ~25m and plan to revert routing in 2h if stable.
sam: follow-ups created: DOCS-345 (dashboard), ALERTS-678 (alert rule changes), RUNBOOK-22 (fallback routing policy). Owners: eng-infra, eng-runtime.
taylor: recommend post-mortem with timeline + decision log + long-term fix to reduce single upstream dependency (gen-proxy-a). tagging @product for impact review.
maria: thanks everyone. closing the active pager rotation on my side. keep an eye on EU synths — ping if >1% 5xx. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident resolved: 5xx-rate back under threshold. incident duration: ~42m. ticket: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-045
